LanguageData.RatkinQL_RaidOutpostTree_Report: A ratkin mercenary broker has a bounty on a warlord outpost.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_RaidOutpost_Greeting: Listen up, {Interviewer_labelShort}. There's a warlord outpost squatting nearby, shaking down every burrow in reach for tribute. My guild's put a bounty on it — clear the place out, keep whatever you loot, and we'll drop a fat purse of silver on top. Interested?
LanguageData.RatkinQL_RaidOutpost_OptAccept: Accept the bounty — march on the outpost.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_RaidOutpost_OptDetails: Tell me more about this outpost.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_RaidOutpost_Details1: Our scouts marked the outpost on your map. Send a war party — the warlord's guards won't go down easy.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_RaidOutpost_Details2: Whatever you strip from their stores is yours to keep. The bounty comes on top of that, paid out once the last of them falls.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_RaidOutpost_Details3: Don't dawdle — camps like that don't sit still forever. Hit it soon, or the offer's off the table.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_RaidOutpost_Farewell: May your blades stay sharp. Good hunting.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_RaidOutpost_MsgAccept: You've taken the bounty. A ratkin mercenary broker marked a warlord outpost on your map — muster your fighters and go finish it.
